name: FMC New Zealand 2022
information: FMC New Zealand 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. This competition is the national championship for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves and is being held in 3 locations across NZ (Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch). No prior experience is necessary but competitors should be aware of what 3x3x3 Fewest Move involves and how to compete.
